answer: Lock a bond per identity, sized near the median epoch reward, and keep it visible as a thread binding that seat to one funded address. Clustered accounts can only share that thread, so faking seats needs fresh capital per node. At epoch close, reviewers dedupe contributions; duplicate work collapses, and each sybil partner's bond burns while its reward moves to a haven of honest verifiers. Slashing exceeds one epoch's payout, so copying a sibling runs at a loss and attacker cost scales with every fake seat. Honest operators hold the bond as an ember reserve and exit whole.
